title: New Client Onboarding
description: Standard intake checklist when adding a new client site to your agency hub.

steps.title: Collect Access Credentials
steps.instructions: Gather hosting panel, DNS, SFTP/SSH, WordPress admin, and domain registrar access. Store in your password manager — never in plaintext tickets.

steps.title: Register Site in LaunchDek
steps.instructions: Add the site URL, create a dedicated Application Password user, run a connection test, and apply client/project tags.

steps.title: Document Theme & Plugin Stack
steps.instructions: Export a plugin list, note custom code locations, page builder used, and any host-specific must-use plugins.

steps.title: Take Baseline Backup
steps.instructions: Create a full backup (files + database) before making changes. Confirm restore procedure with the host or backup plugin.

steps.title: Confirm Staging Environment
steps.instructions: Verify whether staging exists, how to sync prod→staging, and whether search engines are blocked on staging.

steps.title: Define Support Scope
steps.instructions: Document SLA, included hours, escalation contacts, and which plugins/themes the agency supports vs. client-managed.

steps.title: Run Initial Health Baseline
steps.instructions: Record WP/PHP versions, SSL status, update backlog, and PageSpeed scores. Attach to the client record for future drift comparison.
